title: pairedbounds: hidden-bias sensitivity and consistency checks for matched binary outcomes reported without the paired table
description: Code and extracted summary data for recovering Rosenbaum sensitivity values, and checking the internal consistency of reported McNemar results, from published 1:1 matched binary contrasts that do not print the paired 2x2 table. Worked contrasts from neurosurgical and spine studies.
